scope: is_oos == false; doorway is a separate layer; unknown is not converted to ordinary
geometry: Existing processed floor xz in camera-height units and points_1024x512; original point order, reference and score remain unchanged
missingness: Unavailable geometry or unmatched joins remain missing; no fabricated points or reference correspondence

samples.personal_sample: Inherited personal_comparison AND independent_vote_eligible AND peer_n >= 3; formal quality is not required
samples.reference_sample: personal_sample AND inherited quality_usable AND reference_id == current difficulty target_version AND ref_turn5 available
samples.reference_condition_main: reference_sample AND condition == manual AND layer == ordinary
samples.same_image_R5: fixed6 with at least 2 R5 and 2 non-R5 persons on each image
samples.area_sample: Inherited personal_comparison AND independent_vote_eligible AND manual; one row per worker/image; at least 3 observed people on image; reference validity not required
samples.person_pair_support: At least 2 observed distinct images in each compared condition; no missing-condition zero fill
samples.known_GT_issue_expression_records: Source gt_substantive_error OR gt_detail_omission flags among personal_sample; not an independent GT audit

definitions.ref_turn3/ref_turn5/ref_turn10: Reference polygon direction changes strictly greater than 3/5/10 degrees; near-collinear insertions excluded
definitions.annotation_turn5: pair_n - near_straight_nodes_5deg; analogous 3/10-degree count only in sensitivity table
definitions.reduced: annotation_turn5 < ref_turn5; geometric simplification relative to declared reference, not semantic truth of all omitted details
definitions.ref_H: Reused floor_features H under solid opaque polygon assumption; structural self-occlusion proxy, not furniture/RGB visibility or proof of inference difficulty
definitions.ref_short_edges: Reference edge length / perimeter < 0.04 AND both endpoint turns >= 15 degrees
definitions.ref_short_min_horizontal_deg: Minimum shortest cyclic horizontal ray span in degrees among reference short edges; missing if no short edge
definitions.ref_radius_p90_h: 90th percentile reference vertex radius in camera-height units, not metres
definitions.reduction_rate_image_equal: Mean across images of each image's mean reduced indicator
definitions.reduction_rate_building_equal: Within each building average image reduction rates, then average buildings
definitions.rate_delta: Same person's right-condition reduced proportion minus left-condition proportion; answer-weighted within person's condition
definitions.log_area_iqr: 75th - 25th percentile of natural-log camera-height-normalized floor area across observed people on image
definitions.area_peer_absolute_log_deviation: abs(log_area - same-image median log_area); extent/scale spread, not correctness or confirmed scope disagreement
definitions.doorway_delta: Same person's mean area_peer_absolute_log_deviation in doorway minus ordinary
definitions.unmatched_ref_9/unmatched_ref_12: Reused 9/12 degree one-to-one bottom-ray angular assignment diagnostics; not physical semantic correspondence
definitions.R5/H2/Rnew2: Reused frozen exploratory worker classes; R5 subset of H2; Rnew2 derived from replacement study rather than original-answer-only clustering

outputs.record_conditions.csv.gz: Non-OOS rows, inherited expression and correspondence plus reference traits and sample gates; object_id unique
outputs.image_mechanisms.csv: reference_condition_main by image/reference, with count, condition and observed expression diagnostics
outputs.fixed_complexity_summary.csv: Image and building equal reduction summaries by reference effective turn count and mechanism
outputs.person_fixed6_conditions.csv: Observed within-person fixed6 condition contrasts; two contrasts overlap in participants
outputs.same_image_fixed6_R5.csv: Same-image R5/non-R5 reduction comparison, no new class fit
outputs.turn_threshold_sensitivity.csv: 3/5/10 degree count definitions applied to the same fixed6-at-5-degree image cohort
outputs.same_people_clear_curtain.csv: One row per person actually observed on both selected images
outputs.case_person_rows.csv: Observed personal_sample Manual rows on three focus images; not all inventory answers
outputs.person_doorway_area_spread.csv: Observed same-person layer contrasts with at least 2 images each
outputs.area_peer_records.csv.gz: Area-sample object-level deviation and provenance keys
outputs.hard_expression_records.csv: Reference-condition-main rows with inherited coarse hard label and turn-count relation
outputs.hard_expression_images.csv: Hard rows grouped by image/mechanism/count relation; aggregates do not assert semantic errors
outputs.overlay_evidence.json: Exact object_id/reference_id, source photo, preserved-coordinate zoom and short-edge index
outputs.feature_associations.json: Small-panel exploratory Spearman association; no causal or predictive validation

frozen_boundaries: No coarse difficulty relabeling or new official difficulty score
No changes to processed/original points, reference, eligibility, personnel labels, fusion baseline or quality scores
GT-problem rows retained for GT-free expression; formal reference comparison inherits quality gates
No new fusion rerun; same-room fusion findings explicitly reused
N1 not applied; no implied admission/schema/protocol or operational change
